name: Estimate & Scheduler
description: Rapidly edit task estimates and schedule start times across all projects

changelog.1.0.6: Implement all enhancements — hover highlight, remove ±5m/±5h buttons, project colour theming, pinned filter/sort bar, scheduled vs unscheduled visualisation, total estimate footer, keyboard navigation, estimate staleness indicator, schedule propagation to subtasks with confirmation modal
changelog.1.0.5: Call PluginAPI directly in iframe — remove unnecessary postMessage bridge
changelog.1.0.1: Remove dist from tracking, add CI release workflow
changelog.1.0.0: Initial release — task estimate editing and schedule start time picker across all projects
